answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The design leans on succinct non-interactive computational proofs attesting to execution honesty. Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
